pick.headline: Georgia declares independence from the Soviet Union
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of April 10, 1991, carried presidential spokesman Ignatenko saying Gorbachev's reaction to Georgia's declaration of independence would follow the constitution's articles on leaving the union.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 069, 10 April 1991
